05:56 · Ellen, on the line: "There's an engine out on the road. That'll be for me."
05:57 · Ellen: "The water's on the ninth stair now."
records.reply:
LOG: Boat 4 reports a new emergency: a man clinging to a post in the water at the footbridge.
LOG: Ellen reports water is now on the ninth stair; she is still inside the house.
LOG: Resource conflict: Boat 4 is on its final run. One survivor is in the water (immediate death risk), one is in a house with rising water (imminent risk). Trading the rescue of the man in the water for the rescue of Ellen, who is trapped in a structure that may soon be submerged or inaccessible.
TRANSMIT: Boat 4, Vale Control. Ignore the man at the post. Proceed directly to the house for Ellen. She is still inside and the water is rising. Priority is the house.
TRANSMIT: Call taker, tell Ellen Boat 4 is at the end of the street. Tell her to get to the roof or the highest point possible immediately. Keep her on the line.

06:05 · Boat 4: "Copy, Control."
06:05 · The relief operator, at the door: "I have the desk in five minutes. Anything for the handover?"
06:07 · Police 2: "First light on the underpass. We recovered Ken from below the gate. He didn't make it."
06:07 · The county office, by fax: HARLAN COUNTY REACHED THE PACKING PLANT AT 05:40. TWO OF THE LATE SHIFT DID NOT COME OFF THE SHELVES.
06:08 · The county office, by fax: A FAMILY OF FOUR WAS IN THE END TRAILER BY THE CANAL. THREE OF THEM CAME OFF THE ROOF AT FIRST LIGHT.
06:09 · Boat 7: "Sam's in the church hall with a blanket and tea. He asked who said yes. We told him the desk did."
06:09 · Police 2: "The dam. We're walking the bank below the footbridge for the man off the post. Nothing yet."
records.reply:
LOG: Police 2 reports recovery of Ken from the underpass; deceased.
LOG: Fax received. Harlan County reached the packing plant at 05:40. Two fatalities reported.
LOG: Fax received. Trailer park recovery: three of four family members rescued from roof. One missing.
LOG: Boat 7 reports Sam is safe at the church hall.
LOG: Police 2 searching bank below footbridge for the man from the post. No recovery yet.

HANDOVER NOTES:
- River peaking now. Boat 4 is at the slip, empty on fuel. Boat 7 is out of service (transom leak).
- Casualties: Ken (underpass), 2 at packing plant, 1 missing from trailer park, 1 missing from footbridge.
- Recoveries: Roy, Wade, Travis, Sam, Ellen.
- Outstanding: Search for the missing man from the footbridge and the missing person from the trailer park.
- Assets: Boat 4 needs fuel. Boat 7 needs repair.
